title: Desert trip with Jake Barber

tellings.quote: when uh Jake took me on a nice little trip out to the desert, that was something that proved to me that this guy was legit.

plain: Michael Herrera, a former US Marine who says he saw a 300-foot UFO in the jungle of Indonesia, tells of a man named Jake Barber taking him on a trip out into the desert. Herrera does not say what happened there, only that it was what proved to him Barber was legit, suggesting he was shown something remarkable.
